build_linear_crf_model: build a linear-chain CRF model with potentials and transitions graphs using gtn
create_transition_graph: create a bigram transition graph for a given number of output classes
create_potential_graph: create a unary potential graph for a given number of features and classes
run_crf_training: run stochastic gradient descent to train a linear-chain CRF model on sampled data
sample_crf_sequences: sample sequences from a linear-chain CRF model using viterbi decoding
